verdict.rationale: Railway's own docs show its built-in agent and MCP server can set and pull variables and manage environments, so environment-variable management exists. The evidence only shows this through AI-agent workflows, not as a centralized team-level control. missing for 10: team-level access control/RBAC, dedicated secrets management (encryption, sealed/shared secrets), centralized variable management across services/environments, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can manage team-level access, secrets, and environment variables centrally

citations.quote: Create services, set variables, connect databases, wire up networking, and adjust resource limits.
It lets AI assistants create projects, deploy templates, manage environments, pull variables, and redeploy services.
Unlimited environments mean everyone can ship simultaneously.
